notes.title: Beta Update: Fresh Features Await!
notes.content:
Hey Ritualists,

The beta update for Ritualist is here, and it’s loaded with improvements! Check out what’s new:

[list]
[*][b]Visual&Art[/b]: Completely revamped [b]VFX and color palette[/b], [b]polished environments[/b], added [b]currency models and boss visuals[/b] that’ll leave you in awe.
[*][b]Gameplay[/b]: A [b]global map[/b] is available for navigation, and [b]local maps[/b] generate as you enter each stage—no more isolated platforms! Now you can [b]customize and switch weapons in the lobby, unlock abilities through meta-progression[/b], and face smarter enemies with [b]updated AI[/b]. Plus, you'll now discover [b]lootable currency drops[/b], and [b]defeating a boss[/b] finally lets you complete the game (or at least a chapter).
[*][b]UI[/b]: A sleek, functional update with [b]new icons and tweaks[/b] to make your experience smoother.
[*][b]Technical[/b]: A [b]rebuilt animation system[/b] for fluid combat and the [b]integration of FMOD audio[/b] for richer soundscapes (coming soon!). 
[/list]

We are counting on you to test these updates and share your feedback. Let’s make Ritualist the best it can be together!

The Ritualist Team
